AOZ Begleitung

Beyond housing

Open aoz.orangecat.ch → Source Ask about AOZ Begleitung

Shared-living management with a placement engine for refugee housing: compatibility matching across 38 factors, incidents, maintenance, and a resident portal for expenses, rules and votes. Running as a pilot on a real shared flat. AOZ is not a customer; the product exists to show what one would get.

Pilots: Built for a real organisation and in real use. No commercial terms — a working answer, offered first.

The image is a screenshot of aoz.orangecat.ch, taken by a machine when this site was built. If the product changed, so did the picture.
